With print on demand, you can sell custom products online without purchasing or holding inventory yourself.

Here’s how it works:

1. Open your Etsy shop
2. Create a free Printify account and connect it to Etsy
3. Choose a product you want to sell
4. Create and upload your design
5. Customize your title, description, tags and pricing
6. Add eye-catching mockup photos
7. Publish your listing and start selling!

When you receive an order, Printify prints, packages and ships the product directly to your customer. 📦

You can find even more beginner-friendly Etsy and print-on-demand tutorials on my YouTube channel!
